purpose: Defines the only approved default entrypoint for SIKK clean rehydration.
pointer_rules: Pointer must reference approved contract/registry/policy paths explicitly.
Latest approved runs must be listed explicitly; never inferred by mtime or glob.
Pointer is control-plane state only and must not contain raw market data, features, structure signals, decision tickets, or paper results.
A missing pointer makes the next run PATCH_REQUIRED before any data acquisition.
